verdict.rationale: A native mobile app is a fair axis for a project-management tool like Shortcut, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a mobile app, iOS/Android clients, or mobile feature parity. The API, MCP server, and desktop-speed claims are adjacent or off-topic and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
